title: Matching Chest Boats Resorce Pack
description: A small visual tweak that changes the boat chest texture to match the specific wood type of the boat.
body:
Ever wondered why a chest in a mangrove or cherry boat always looks like basic oak?

This resource pack fixes that minor inconsistency!

It dynamically changes the chest texture to perfectly match the wood type of the boat it's placed in.

Enjoy a more cohesive and visually pleasing look during your maritime adventures!
